title: Live game connection state diagram
description: The WebSocket an online game in play keeps to the Worker (api/games/{id}/live, answered by the game's GameRoom). Api.Live polls the socket every frame in _process and reconnects with back-off: half a second, doubling to at most 15 seconds, reset once a connection opens. It tells the game screen when the connection goes down (once per outage) and up again; the screen shows Reconnecting… meanwhile. The server sends the whole game on connecting and after every change, and pong to a ping; only state messages are used.
machine: Api.Live (godot/scripts/api.gd): the WebSocketPeer's ready state with _wait, _retry, _was_open and _said_down

states.description: A new WebSocketPeer is connecting to the game's live URL (ws:// or wss:// from Api.base), with a Bearer header when Api.token is set (desktop).
Connected: every state message is emitted to the game screen, and "ping" goes out every 25 seconds.
The socket closed or could not open: waiting _wait seconds before trying again.
close() was called (the game screen left the tree): the socket is closed and polling stops.

transitions.action: emit state(game); the screen applies it.

transitions.trigger: 25 seconds of _process since the last ping

transitions.action: emit connection(false) unless already said since the last time it was up; _was_open = false; _wait = _retry; _retry = min(15, _retry × 2).
